"Diesel is so high people I know who never wanted an EV are now talking about buying one," she wrote.
He added, "It’s mind-blowing to realize that Trump is ushering in the Green New Deal better than Democrats ever did by literally destroying American’s ability to afford gas and diesel."
Greene contrasted Trump’s approach with Democrats’ EV policies, writing, "Democrats were going to force you to drive EV’s and gave you a tax credit."
"Trump is going to force you by making you go broke and giving in but without a tax credit," Greene wrote. "I guess no matter who you vote for you get the Green New Deal. It’s insanity."
